verdict.rationale: Zapier MCP lets you create an MCP server, pick tools from 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions, reuse existing app connections, and connect any MCP client with a connection token. It also offers managed and agentic modes, tool bundles, and team access controls, which squarely covers exposing connected app actions as MCP tools for external agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and explicit evidence that existing Zap workflows (not just app actions) can be exposed as tools.
